   Target: Q4 CY2024

[8-K Q4 FY2023 — Full Document] EX-99.1 2 q4fy23pr.htm Q4FY23 PRESS RELEASE Document FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2023 • Quarterly revenue of $6.05 billion, down 21% from a year ago • Fiscal-year revenue of $27.0 billion, flat from a year ago • Quarterly and annual return to shareholders of $1.15 billion and $10.44 billion, respectively SANTA CLARA, Calif.-Feb. 22, 2023- NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today reported revenue for the fourth quarter ended January 29, 2023, of $6.05 billion, down 21% from a year ago and up 2% from the previous quarter.
[NVDA_Q4_2023] Revenue of $226 million was up 13% sequentially and down 65% from a year ago.
[NVDA_Q4_2023] Fiscal year revenue of $1.54 billion was down 27%.
[NVDA_Q4_2023] Revenue was a record $294 million, up 17% and up 135% from a year ago.
[NVDA_Q4_2023] Fiscal year revenue of $903 million was up 60%.
[NVDA_Q4_2023] GAAP gross margin was 63.3%
[NVDA_Q4_2023] non-GAAP gross margin was 66.1%.
